decisions.condition: A bearish candle is the final opposite candle before an approved bullish departure.
decisions.outcome: Start or replace the demand candidate at that candle.

decisions.condition: A bullish candle is the final opposite candle before an approved bearish departure.
decisions.outcome: Start or replace the supply candidate at that candle.

decisions.condition: The same-direction departure closes beyond the origin extreme.
decisions.outcome: Confirm a fresh zone on the closed five-minute bar.
Use the origin range plus any permitted formation-envelope distal extension.

decisions.condition: The bearish demand origin high is above the first bullish departure high.
decisions.outcome: Use the full origin body before applying the permitted distal extension.

decisions.condition: The bullish supply origin low is below the first bearish departure low.
decisions.outcome: Use the full origin body before applying the permitted distal extension.

decisions.condition: Consecutive bullish formation candles print lower lows before demand confirmation.
decisions.outcome: Extend only the demand distal boundary downward.

decisions.condition: Consecutive bearish formation candles print higher highs before supply confirmation.
decisions.outcome: Extend only the supply distal boundary upward.

decisions.condition: The pre-origin approach candle has a known direction.
decisions.outcome: Classify continuation when approach matches departure direction; otherwise reversal.

decisions.condition: The origin has no prior bar or its approach candle is a doji.
decisions.outcome: Reject the candidate without guessing a formation class.

decisions.condition: An opposite-color candle appears after formation starts and before confirmation.

decisions.outcome: Freeze top and bottom for the full lifecycle.

decisions.condition: A later bar overlaps the frozen zone and does not close beyond the distal boundary.
decisions.outcome: Change the lifecycle state from fresh to tapped.

decisions.condition: A later overlapping bar closes beyond the frozen distal boundary.
decisions.outcome: Change the lifecycle state from fresh to invalidated.

conflicts.resolution: Use the full origin body for accuracy geometry, matching the canonical RD explanation; do not retain the legacy partial wick segment.
Same-direction wick overlap before confirmation extends the formation envelope; only bars after confirmation can tap the frozen zone.
Replace an unformed candidate with each newer opposite candle so the final opposite candle becomes the origin.
